objects.taxonomy_description: Large ferocious bear of Eurasia with a thick, shaggy coat in various shades of brown. Ears are small, rounded, and set wide apart. Tail is very short and hidden in fur. Eyes are small, dark, and deep-set. The breed's signature features include its massive size, shoulder hump, dished face profile, and variable brown coat color.
